verdict.rationale: Codex documents signing in with a ChatGPT account under a Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan, which is an enterprise-plan authentication path, plus an API-key option. Nothing shows SSO/SAML through an enterprise identity provider or authentication via a cloud platform such as Azure, Bedrock, or Vertex. The RBAC page covers the OpenAI API and Dashboard rather than Codex sign-in, so it is adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: documented SSO/IdP integration (SAML/OIDC, SCIM), cloud-platform authentication routes, Codex-specific enterprise admin/compliance controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability

citations.quote: Run `codex` and select **Sign in with ChatGPT**. We recommend signing into your ChatGPT account to use Codex as part of your Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan.
You can also use Codex with an API key, but this requires additional setup.
